Gifted: Encore.description:
🧬 Encore, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 Start within six meters: steady allies, upset an opponent's step, supply music and a soft spotlight, and physically repeat a simple move with "Encore".
📈 Attention stores power. Training adds capture footwork, leaps, crowd evacuation and stronger audience flourishes; replays never reverse time or copy another Quirk.
⚠️ Silence, being ignored and noise that buries your beat weaken you. Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, from performing and repeating moves.
⚖️ Venues may require permission; forced movement needs self-defense or licensed duty. Nobody must sing, dance or follow orders.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Present Mic (Voice), for vocal delivery only.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Encore.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Encore family): Scale: sound organs give rhythmic pressure, tones, a soft glow. New adult user, six meters: steadies two willing allies or unbalances a listener's step; "Encore" re-performs a simple move bodily; training widens it. Limits: bodies only, not minds or Quirk activation; nobody must sing or dance; no free sound or solid light. Earplugs, soundproofing, silence or louder noise stop it. Charges: +1 per turn with an attentive live observer (any side) in hearing, max 3; crowds, recordings, being ignored: none; a broken beat clears all; never replaces stamina. Replays undo, restore and copy nothing. Quirk Strain: light: opening beat; moderate: reprise, capture footwork, palm strike, leap; heavy: evacuation, audience flourish; severe: signature formation, company rhythm, awakened performances; reprises: double exertion. Type: Emitter. Law: venue permits where required; forced movement or restraint outside self-defense or licensed duty is assault.
